neighbours.label: a narrative time-span phrase that links to the preceding stretch of a life story ('the next two years', 'during this time', 'this period'), as against the same sentences without the span
fire: He left the army in 1946 and spent the next three years farming in Ohio.
She joined the orchestra in 1971. During this time, she also taught violin.
After the treaty, trade grew rapidly during this period of peace.
Lewis moved to London and spent the next decade writing for newspapers.
They married in 1920; during this time they lived above a bakery.
The firm went public in 1998 and spent the next two years expanding abroad.
Prices doubled in 1974, and during this period many factories closed.
He graduated in 1955 and spent the next four years as a ship's doctor.

She joined the orchestra in 1971 and also taught violin.
